RC-017.note: Successful native region screenshot acquisition now sends only geometry to an OwnedWork worker before post-capture actions. LastRegionStore uses PrivateJsonFile atomic owner-only version-1 writes with snapshot fencing. Valid prior records and compatible unknown fields round-trip; corrupt/newer/stale/unsafe records are preserved. Cancellation/denial/failed composition and recording-region picking never invoke this writer. Metadata failure retains normal successful output and appears in the final notification, including workflow-processing admission failure. Native single-display payload ordering, worker liveness/teardown and storage tests are candidate evidence; physical display identity/mapping, crash/power-loss and full target qualification remain Required.
